## Core Engineering Pillars

### 01 // Frontend Architecture
Engineers zero-bloat, sub-second client applications prioritizing strict TypeScript typing, semantic HTML5, responsive fluid CSS variables, Tailwind CSS v4 layout architecture, and modular React 19 components. Optimized for Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) with static HTML pre-rendering, self-hosted variable WOFF2 fonts, AVIF/WebP responsive imagery, and zero layout thrashing.

### 02 // AI & Creative Motion
Crafts tactile 60fps user experiences including hardware-accelerated CSS radial spotlight reveals, dynamic offscreen canvas masking, cursor-following shaders, parallax SVG grids, and production integrations with Generative AI models such as Google Gemini AI.

### 03 // Platforms & Production CI/CD
Maintains standardized shipping workflows utilizing Vite 6 bundling, automated GitHub Actions & Netlify CI/CD pipelines, Git version control, RESTful API integration, and Figma-to-code precision execution.
